moves: Brew thermostat: unplug Ba and Bb and join them with J. The thermocouple goes in the thermostat's place.
Steam thermostat: unplug Sa and Sb and plug them onto wires Sa and Sb from the SSR. The thermostat can stay, disconnected, or come out.
Pump: unplug Pb and plug it onto wire 3. Wire P goes on the terminal Pb came off, and N piggybacks on Pa.
Brew switch: unplug B4 from spade 4 and plug it onto L. Spade 4 stays empty.
Steam switch: move S4 from spade 4 to spade 1. Unplug S5 and park it: it stays live, so insulate its end and tie it down.
Lamps: the steam lamp now sits across the SSR, so it lights when the boiler isn't heating. The brew lamp goes dark for good, and the power lamp works as before.

Evo Pro and E24: on most, each switch's connectors sit together in one combined block. Take each connector out, insulate it on its own and label it before you start, because some stay in the machine unplugged. The official parts list adds self-fusing silicone tape for this.
keep: Power switch and power lamp: unchanged.
Pump thermal fuse (110 °C) and boiler thermal fuse (184 °C): unchanged.
Steam switch spades 2 and 3 still carry mains as they did stock, and spade 1 now does too, because S4 moves there.
Brew switch spade 5 stays on the valve's feed, which the PCB now drives, so empty spade 4 is live too whenever brew is on and the valve is open. Keep it clear of everything.
Low-voltage wires go only on brew spades 1 and 2, which were empty, and steam spades 4 and 5, which this install frees.
As drawn, the SSR sits on the elements' neutral side, so the elements stay connected to line whenever the machine is on, heating or not.
Valve, heating elements and earth wires: unchanged.

moves: Brew thermostat: unplug Ba and Bb and join them with J. The thermocouple goes in the thermostat's place.
Steam thermostat: unplug Sa and Sb and plug them onto wires Sa and Sb from the SSR. The thermostat can stay, disconnected, or come out.
Pump: unplug Pb and plug it onto wire 3. Wire P goes on the terminal Pb came off, and N piggybacks on the other terminal.
Switch housing: unplug P1-2, the brew switch's common, and plug it onto L.
Switch housing: unplug 1, 2, 3 and P3-4 and park them. All four stay live: insulate each end and tie it down. Where a connector holds two wires, leave them joined in it.

keep: On/off switch and its lamp: unchanged.

Earth: most 120 V Classics left the factory with none. Fit the official grounding retrofit before anything else.
Steam switch P(5-6) and 6 still carry mains, as they did stock: the valve's feed runs through them. Low-voltage wires go only on the spades this install frees: 1, 3, P(1-2) and P(3-4).
